panels.title: DNS resolve time — Pi-hole vs upstream
panels.description: Actual DNS query round-trip. Uses probe_duration_seconds, NOT probe_dns_lookup_time_seconds — the latter measures resolving the target's own hostname and is always 0 when the target is an IP address. Your local resolver should BEAT the upstreams, because it caches. If the local_dns line sits above them, that is backwards and DNS is your bottleneck.

panels.title: Queries per client — COUNTS, NOT BYTES
panels.description: Finds an IoT device hammering DNS. Will NOT find a device streaming 4K — that is few queries and enormous traffic. Byte-level attribution needs flow data the current topology cannot provide (spec §2.5). Metric name is unverified against the v6 exporter (ekofr/pihole-exporter:v1.0.0 exposes per-client counts as pihole_top_sources{source=...}, not pihole_client_queries) — this panel may be empty until confirmed.
